steps.note: Start the eRFX creation flow.
Enable eRFX project creation for the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the required project title.
Create the Technical + RFQ stage pair.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the bid.
Publish the configured event.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal session.
Open the Technical Stage from the vendor portal.
Verify the RFQ-only clause is not shown on the Technical Stage.
Verify the second RFQ-only clause is not shown on the Technical Stage.
Open the RFQ pricing round where the terms must be accepted.
Verify the first clause is visible to the vendor on the RFQ.
Verify the second clause is visible to the vendor on the RFQ.
Accept the first mandatory clause.
Accept the second mandatory clause.
Submit the vendor's quote after accepting both clauses.
Verify the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
